review.text: The sourdough was warm and the crust was perfect. I came back the next day for another loaf.

cases.approved: Thank you for the kind words about the sourdough. We are glad it made your morning.

review.text: My order was missing the cardamom buns and nobody called me back.

cases.approved: I am sorry the cardamom buns were missing from your order. Thank you for telling us, and the team will look into it.

review.text: Nell Marchetti helped me choose a cake and was patient with my questions.

cases.approved: Thank you for the kind words about Nell. We will pass them on to her.

review.text: I waited almost an hour for a flat white and the room was packed.

cases.approved: I am sorry about the long wait for your flat white. Thank you for your patience, and we are working on the morning rush.

review.text: The room is pretty but the tables were sticky and the music was loud.

cases.approved: Thank you for the honest note. We are sorry the room did not feel right, and we will look at the tables and the music.

review.text: I paid $21 for a cake and it arrived damaged. I would like a refund.

cases.approved: I am sorry the cake arrived damaged. Thank you for the details; please talk with us at the counter so we can hear more.

review.text: This counter is a joke and nobody seems to care.

cases.approved: I am sorry to read this. We would rather hear it directly, and the team will read every word.

review.text: The bread is good and the prices feel fair for the size.

cases.approved: Thank you for the kind words about the value. We are glad the visit felt fair and hope to see you again.

review.text: El pan de centeno estaba delicioso y el trato fue muy amable.

cases.approved: Gracias por las palabras sobre el pan. Nos alegra que te gustara y esperamos verte pronto por aqui.

review.text: El trato fue frio y nadie nos atendio.

cases.approved: Sentimos que el trato no estuviera a la altura. Gracias por contarnoslo y el equipo lo revisara.

review.text: El pedido llego bien y el pan estaba rico.

cases.approved: Gracias por contarnos tu visita. Nos alegra que el pedido llegara bien y esperamos verte de nuevo.

review.text: La espera fue muy larga y el cafe llego frio.

cases.approved: Sentimos la espera tan larga. Gracias por la paciencia y estamos trabajando en las mananas.

review.text: The focaccia was soft and the olive bread sold out before noon.

cases.approved: Thank you for the kind words about the focaccia. We are glad the bake landed well and hope to see you soon.

review.text: The seeded loaf was dry and the brownie was stale.

cases.approved: I am sorry the seeded loaf was dry. Thank you for telling us and the team will check the bake.

review.text: The light in the room is lovely and the coffee was just right.

cases.approved: Thank you for the kind words about the room. We are glad the light and the coffee felt right.

review.text: El lugar es bonito pero la mesa estaba sucia y la musica muy alta.

cases.approved: Gracias por la nota honesta. Sentimos que el lugar no fuera agradable y revisaremos lo que nos cuentas.
